name: Driver Notice of License Suspension or Disqualification
description: Notice of suspension, revocation, cancellation, loss or disqualification of driving privileges.
recipient: Superintendent or designee and contract carrier
deadline: immediately upon reporting to work for the next scheduled shift
quote: shall notify the Superintendent or designee and the contract carrier immediately upon reporting to work for the next scheduled shift following the notice of the suspension, revocation, cancellation, loss or disqualification.
